products.name: Lovo (Genny)
products.note: Voice cloning and synthesis; likeness consent; commercial voiceover; synthetic media disclosure

reading.body:
Lovo offers a single product, Genny, in the voice and audio category, with its recorded scope limited to voice cloning, voice synthesis, commercial voiceover, and synthetic media disclosure practices including likeness consent.

The disclosure and consent framing is the notable detail here. Most capability descriptions stop at what a product does technically. The inclusion of likeness consent and synthetic media disclosure signals that Lovo's public positioning addresses not just the audio output but the conditions under which that output is legitimately created and used.

The data does not cover infrastructure, compute requirements, power draw, or facility footprint, so no connection to grid or building constraints can be drawn from it. It also contains no case studies, pricing, or model architecture information. What it establishes is category and stated scope, nothing more.
